naslov: NBA teams reveal court designs for 2026 NBA Cup tournament
tekst:
Teams have revealed their court designs for this year's Emirates NBA Cup.
The fourth edition of the league's in-season tournament runs from Oct. 30 to Dec. 11, with teams competing for bragging rights, a trophy and more than $500,000 in prize money for each member of the winning squad. The courts reflect the prestige of the event, with the NBA Cup trophy featured in the center and under each basket as a common element.
